Fluorescence_Compatibility.Text1:
markers:
marker_id: M01
signal: endogenous tissue AF
exogenous_label: false
role: 整块3D成像对比
material: 已固定透明人胰腺组织
details: 短波解剖/血管及导管样结构；NIR胰岛样结构；PDAC相对低AF区
source_locator: S01:Figs2–5; S02:S1/S2
boundary: AF荧光物质不等于insulin；lipofuscin-like pigment为候选解释。
display_color_boundary: Fig3f/i、Fig5c/f及V06/V07中的红色管状结构与绿色胰岛是AF通道或分割对象的显示伪色，不代表红/绿外源染料或另加标记。

Fluorescence_Compatibility.Text2:
markers:
marker_id: M02
signal: H&E / HTEX
exogenous_label: true
role: 成像后常规切片形态验证
material: formalin固定组织石蜡切片
details: 用于PDAC/IPMN/PanIN对照；本文未给该石蜡切片厚度
source_locator: S01:p4 IHC; Figs2h/3e/4a
boundary: 不是整块AF采集前染色。

Fluorescence_Compatibility.Text3:
markers:
marker_id: M03
signal: CK18
exogenous_label: true
role: 成像后上皮结构验证
material: 组织石蜡切片
details: rabbit anti-cytokeratin18, Abcam ab52948, 1:50；Ventana Benchmark；citrate pH6.0、94°C、8 min抗原修复
source_locator: S01:p4 IHC; Fig2i/3h
boundary: 局部形态对应，非特异肿瘤分类器；未给该分支显色/二抗完整细节。

Fluorescence_Compatibility.Text4:
markers:
marker_id: M04
signal: aSMA
exogenous_label: true
role: 成像后大血管/平滑肌结构验证
material: 组织石蜡切片
details: rabbit anti-alpha smooth muscle actin, Abcam ab5694, 1:200；Ventana Benchmark；同上抗原修复
source_locator: S01:p4 IHC; Fig2j/3j
boundary: 管状AF仅部分重叠aSMA，不能把全部管状AF直接计为血管。

Fluorescence_Compatibility.Text5:
markers:
marker_id: M05
signal: insulin immunofluorescence
exogenous_label: true
role: 薄切片验证NIR胰岛AF身份
material: 连续20 μm冷冻切片
details: guinea pig anti-insulin DAKO A0564 1:500；Alexa Fluor488 goat anti-guinea pig Invitrogen A11073 1:500
source_locator: S01:p4 IHC; p8 Fig5g–i
boundary: 连续切片：g未染短波、h染insulin、i未染NIR；不是同片共定位或整块3D免疫标记。
